changelog:
Initial release of groq-whisper-api as a clone of a built-in openai-whisper-api skill (but 10x cheaper than OpenAI API).

- Transcribe audio files using Groq's Whisper ASR model via simple shell scripts
- Supports model selection, language specification, custom prompts, and output formatting (plain text or JSON)
- Requires curl and a GROQ_API_KEY for authentication
- Easy configuration via environment variable or config file
display_name: Transcribe audio via Groq API (~10x cheaper than OpenAI API)
summary: Transcribe audio via Groq Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) Models (Whisper).
